candidates.change_summary: Replace `_owner` with `address(0)` in the return statement so `owner()` always returns the zero address.
Replace `_owner` with `_msgSender()` so `owner()` returns the caller instead of the stored owner.
Replace `_owner` with a hardcoded non-zero address so `owner()` always returns that fixed address.
Remove the require check that newOwner is not the zero address, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to address(0).
Call _transferOwnership with msg.sender instead of the newOwner parameter, so ownership is always transferred to the caller.
Call _transferOwnership with the zero address instead of newOwner, destroying ownership.
Remove the call to _transferOwnership so the function exits without changing owner, making it a no-op.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner, removing access control and allowing anyone to call transferOwnership.
Replace the require condition with true, effectively removing the access control check so anyone can call transferOwnership.
